original_content.script_excerpt: When engineer Nila rotates the triangular copper loop between the magnets, the needle in her nearby electrical meter swings to the other side. The direction of motion changes the signal.
original_content.scene_goal: One original human action, two physical connected instrument objects and the change of one needle's angle are unmistakable at a glance. This is an illustration-style test, not a motion-ready film claim.
new_subjects: triangular copper test loop with actual support handle
small analog needle meter with a single magnetic housing
